scores.question: What GAAP EPS guidance did Qualcomm give for its fiscal Q3 2026, and how did the result compare?
failure_details: 0 llm_unsupported: Company guided non-GAAP diluted EPS to $2.10 to $2.30.: Cited E1 is GAAP-only; it does not state any non-GAAP EPS range.
1 numbers_cited: a sentence with a number has no citation: The plausibility check flagged the GAAP guidance row because the guided $1.36 is 20% of fiscal Q2's $6.88 EPS.
1 numbers_cited: a sentence with a number has no citation: The tool marks that range as not comparable with the GAAP result, so I have not compared it with the $1.87 actual.
scores.answer:
Qualcomm guided fiscal Q3 2026 GAAP diluted EPS to $1.26 to $1.46 in its fiscal Q2 release on April 29, 2026 [1]. Actual GAAP diluted EPS was $1.87, as reported in the 10-Q filed July 29, 2026 [2], which is above the top of the range. Measured against the $1.36 midpoint, that is a beat of $0.51, or 37.5% [1].
The plausibility check flagged the GAAP guidance row because the guided $1.36 is 20% of fiscal Q2's $6.88 EPS; the reviewer marked it as ok [1].
Qualcomm also gave non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance of $2.10 to $2.30 in the same release [1]. That range is not comparable with the GAAP result, so I have not compared it with the $1.87 actual [1].

Sources:
[1] QCOM earnings release for FY2026Q2, filed 2026-04-29: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/804328/000080432826000060/qcom032926erex991.htm
[2] QCOM 10-Q filed 2026-07-29: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/804328/000080432826000086/qcom-20260628.htm

scores.question: What revenue did AMD guide for Q2 2026, and did it meet that guidance?
scores.answer:
AMD met and beat its Q2 2026 revenue guidance. It guided to approximately $11.2 billion, plus or minus $300 million (a range of $10.9 billion to $11.5 billion) [1]. Reported Q2 revenue was $11,536M, about $336M (3.0%) above the midpoint [1][2].

Sources:
[1] AMD earnings release for FY2026Q1, filed 2026-05-05: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000072/q12026991.htm
[2] AMD 10-Q filed 2026-08-05: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000123/amd-20260627.htm

scores.question: What is the trend in Meta's capex over the last four quarters, Q3 2025 to Q2 2026?
failure_details: 0 llm_unsupported: Figures are SEC-filing-based; Q4 2025 and Q1 2026 were derived from YTD values.: E3 (Q1 2026) is not marked derived; only Q4 2025 and Q2 2026 are derived.
scores.answer:
Meta's quarterly capex rose overall from Q3 2025 to Q2 2026, with one dip in Q1 2026.
- Q3 2025: $18,829M [1]. This is a derived value (nine-month year-to-date less six-month year-to-date) [1].
- Q4 2025: $21,383M [2]. This is a derived value (twelve-month year-to-date less nine-month year-to-date) [2].
- Q1 2026: $18,997M [3]. This is a reported value, not derived [3].
- Q2 2026: $30,116M [4]. This is a derived value (six-month year-to-date less Q1) [4].
Computed changes:
- Q3 2025 to Q2 2026: up 59.94% [1][4].
- Q3 2025 to Q4 2025: up 13.56% [1][2].
- Q4 2025 to Q1 2026: down 11.16% [2][3].
- Q1 2026 to Q2 2026: up 58.53% [3][4].
Capex rose in Q4 2025, fell in Q1 2026, then rose sharply in Q2 2026, the largest quarterly increase of the four quarters [1][2][2][3][3][4]. All figures come from SEC filings [1][2][3][4].

Sources:
[1] META 10-Q filed 2025-10-30: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828025047240/meta-20250930.htm
[2] META 10-K filed 2026-01-29: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026003942/meta-20251231.htm
[3] META 10-Q filed 2026-04-30: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026028526/meta-20260331.htm
[4] META 10-Q filed 2026-07-30: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026050705/meta-20260630.htm
